plan.plan:
{
  "title": "IA (Inspection Authorization) qualifications, major repair / major alteration authority, and renewal requirements \u2014 verified 14 CFR compliance memo",
  "scope_statement": "Produce a regulatory compliance memo answering three questions about the FAA Inspection Authorization (IA) held by an A&P mechanic: (1) every eligibility requirement for issuance of the IA, (2) the privileges and limitations that govern approval of major repairs and major alterations for return to service, and (3) what is required to keep the IA current (renewal and activity requirements). Every requirement must carry a 14 CFR citation at section level, and every item that could not be confirmed against the current eCFR text must be named explicitly. The drafting environment has no eCFR retrieval capability, so the memo ships as a verified-once-executed matrix: a complete 28-row Compliance Evidence Matrix with best-recall citations, each row labelled UNVERIFIED with a kill trigger, plus a mechanical verification procedure that converts each row to VERIFIED or REFUTED.",
  "authoritative_framework": [
    "Regulatory authority (binding): 14 CFR part 65 subpart D (Inspection Authorization) \u2014 eligibility, application/issue, privileges and limitations, duration/renewal of the IA; 14 CFR part 65 subpart B (Mechanics) \u00a7\u00a7 65.71\u201365.89 \u2014 the underlying A&P certificate, ratings, and return-to-service privilege that the IA builds on.",
    "Regulatory authority (binding, cross-cutting): 14 CFR part 43 \u2014 \u00a7 43.7 (persons authorized to approve a major repair or major alteration for return to service), \u00a7 43.9 (content, form and disposition of maintenance records, FAA Form 337), \u00a7 43.11 (inspections), \u00a7 43.13 (performance rules / data approved by the Administrator), \u00a7 43.15 (annual and 100-hour inspections), Appendix A to part 43 (major alterations, major repairs, preventive maintenance lists), Appendix D to part 43 (scope of annual and 100-hour inspections); 14 CFR \u00a7 1.1 (definitions of 'major alteration', 'major repair', 'preventive maintenance', 'airworthy').",
    "Non-regulatory guidance (may be cited for procedure only, never as the rule): FAA Order 8900.1 (Flight Standards) IA chapters, FAA Form 337 instructions, FAA airman testing standards / test guide for the IA knowledge test. All guidance citations must be visually distinguished from 14 CFR citations in the memo.",
    "Source of truth for text: https://www.ecfr.gov/ (entry point https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-14 ; machine-readable retrieval via the eCFR versioner API documented at https://www.ecfr.gov/developers/documentation/api ). Record the eCFR 'current as of' date and the annual CFR edition date for every extract."
  ],
  "canonical_numbers": [

      "value": "18 years",
      "meaning": "minimum age for IA eligibility",
      "where_used": "row A1"
    },

      "meaning": "look-back window for renewal activity",
      "where_used": "rows C3, C5"
    },

      "meaning": "minimum qualifying activity count inside the renewal look-back",
      "where_used": "row C3"
    },
    {

      "where_used": "phase 3"
    },
    {

    {

      "where_used": "effort derivation, cost note"
    },
    {

      "value": "2 workers",
      "meaning": "Regulatory Specialist + Test Engineer",
      "where_used": "effort derivation"
    },
    {
      "id": "CN-17",
      "value": "198 person-min each, remainder 0 person-min",
      "meaning": "CN-15 divided by CN-16",
      "where_used": "effort derivation"
    },
    {

      "meaning": "28 verification items + 6 re-checks",
      "where_used": "Little's Law check"
    },

      "meaning": "parallel execution of CN-15 across CN-16",
      "where_used": "effort derivation"
    },
    {
      "id": "CN-20",
      "value": "0 of 28 rows VERIFIED",
      "meaning": "verification state as of drafting (28 UNVERIFIED)",
      "where_used": "blockers, could-not-verify list, falsifier baseline"
    }
  ],
  "phases": [
    {
      "id": "P0",
      "name": "Freeze scope, canonical numbers, matrix skeleton",
      "owner": "Regulatory Specialist",
      "actions": [
        "Lock the canonical number table (CN-01\u2026CN-20) and copy it into the memo verbatim; no other figure may be introduced without a new CN id.",
        "Create the Compliance Evidence Matrix skeleton with exactly CN-09 = 28 rows (CN-07 = 25 positive rows A1\u2013A7, B1\u2013B7, C1\u2013C6, D1\u2013D5; CN-08 = 3 negative rows N1\u2013N3) and the four per-row fields: citation, operative clause, verification status, kill trigger.",
        "Declare scope exclusions in the memo (see 'scope_exclusions') so that no reader mistakes this memo for authority on airworthiness-certificate issuance or on repair-station (part 145) approval paths."
      ],
      "outputs": [
        "canonical number table",
        "28-row matrix skeleton",
        "scope exclusion statement"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "P1",
      "name": "Evidence acquisition from eCFR",
      "owner": "Regulatory Specialist",
      "actions": [
        "Retrieve the current eCFR text of: 14 CFR \u00a7 1.1 (definitions); 14 CFR \u00a7\u00a7 43.7, 43.9, 43.11, 43.13, 43.15 and Appendices A and D to part 43; 14 CFR part 65 subpart B (all sections) and the entirety of 14 CFR part 65 subpart D (applicability, eligibility, application and issue, privileges and limitations, duration and renewal).",
        "Record for every extract: retrieval timestamp, eCFR 'current as of' banner date, annual CFR edition date, the exact section and paragraph numbering as published (e.g. \u00a7 65.93(a)), and the amendment/version history shown by eCFR.",
        "Store the verbatim clause for each row in an evidence log keyed by row id (A1 \u2026 N3). Verbatim capture is mandatory: the memo must not present any quotation that was not copied from the retrieved text.",
        "Confirm the part 65 subpart map from the eCFR table of contents (which subpart is 'Inspection Authorization', and the section numbers it actually contains) before any citation is written."
      ],
      "outputs": [
        "dated evidence log with verbatim clauses",
        "verified section map of 14 CFR part 65",
        "retrieval/edition metadata block for the memo"
      ],
      "kill_triggers": [
        "KT-A (section map differs from assumption)",
        "KT-G (an amendment with a later effective date appears)"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "P2",
      "name": "Row-by-row verification (primary pass)",
      "owner": "Regulatory Specialist",
      "actions": [
        "For each of the CN-07 = 25 positive rows: locate the paragraph in the retrieved text, compare the draft clause to the verbatim clause, and assign one status \u2014 VERIFIED (meaning identical, verbatim captured), PARTIAL (meaning holds, wording or paragraph letter differs; update the row and re-record), or REFUTED (no such condition, or the text contradicts the row).",
        "For each of the CN-08 = 3 negative rows (N1\u2013N3): run full-text searches over the retrieved part 65 subpart D text using the strings 'citizen', 'resident', 'alien', 'school', 'training', 'course', 'part 147', 'hours', 'number of aircraft', and record the result counts as absence evidence; then scan part 65 subpart B and part 43 for any contrary requirement.",
        "Settle row B7 (self-approval) by searching part 43 and part 65 for restrictions on a person approving for return to service maintenance that the same person performed; record the exact sentence or record the absence.",
        "Update the status column; no row may remain silent. Rows still unconfirmed stay UNVERIFIED and move into the could-not-verify list with the reason."
      ],
      "outputs": [
        "verified matrix (25 positive rows processed at CN-11 = 12 min each = 300 person-min)",
        "absence-evidence log (3 negative rows at CN-12 = 8 min each = 24 person-min)"
      ],
      "kill_triggers": [
        "KT-B (A4 window wrong)",
        "KT-D (B1 authority wrong)",
        "KT-E (B7 prohibition found)",
        "KT-F (B5 Form 337 requirement differs)"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "P3",
      "name": "Independent re-check of high-risk rows",
      "owner": "Test Engineer",
      "actions": [
        "Independently re-derive the CN-10 = 6 high-risk rows (A4, A6, B1, B7, C1, C3) directly from the retrieved eCFR text without looking at the primary drafter's notes; effort 6 \u00d7 CN-11 = 6 \u00d7 12 = 72 person-min (CN-14).",
        "Compute the falsifier metric M (see 'falsifier') and record it in the memo's validation section.",
        "Any disagreement between the primary pass and the re-check is itself a refutation of that row and forces re-derivation from the retrieved text before sign-off."
      ],
      "outputs": [
        "signed re-check record",
        "measured value of M"
      ],
      "kill_triggers": [
        "M \u2265 1"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "P4",
      "name": "Number and consistency audit + currency check",
      "owner": "Regulatory Specialist + Test Engineer",
      "actions": [
        "Walk every figure in the memo against the canonical number table; every age, rating count, month window, activity count, row count, and minute figure must match its CN entry exactly or be given a new CN id.",
        "Cross-check that the eligibility window (CN-03 = 24 months), the renewal cycle (CN-04 = 24 months), and the renewal look-back (CN-05 = 24 months) are stated identically wherever they appear and are not silently conflated.",
        "Re-open the eCFR page for part 65 and part 43 and confirm no amendment became effective between the P1 retrieval date and publication; if one did, re-run P2 for all 28 rows (KT-G).",
        "Confirm that every 14 CFR citation is section-level as the request requires, that paragraph letters are marked as best-recall where not captured verbatim, and that every FAA Order / form citation is visually marked as non-regulatory guidance."
      ],
      "outputs": [
        "consistency audit note",
        "currency attestation with the eCFR 'current as of' date"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "P5",
      "name": "Publish the compliance memo",
      "owner": "Regulatory Specialist",
      "actions": [
        "Assemble in this order: (1) scope and authority; (2) eligibility table (A1\u2013A7); (3) privileges and limitations for major repairs and major alterations (B1\u2013B7); (4) renewal and activity requirements (C1\u2013C6) with the window arithmetic written out; (5) definitions and cross-references (D1\u2013D5); (6) negative findings (N1\u2013N3); (7) could-not-verify list; (8) kill triggers and change control; (9) evidence log and validation.",
        "Write each requirement as a complete sentence with its citation inline, e.g. 'The applicant must be at least 18 years old \u2014 14 CFR \u00a7 65.93 (paragraph letter per retrieved text), status VERIFIED/UNVERIFIED, evidence E-A1.'",
        "Never present an unverified row in confirmatory language; unverified rows must carry the literal word UNVERIFIED in the same sentence as the claim."
      ],
      "outputs": [
        "published IA qualification, major repair/alteration, and renewal compliance memo"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "P6",
      "name": "Validation and release gate",
      "owner": "Test Engineer",
      "actions": [
        "Evaluate each success criterion by reading the memo only; record pass/fail per criterion with the sentence that satisfies it quoted.",
        "Release gate: the memo may be relied upon for compliance advice only if M = 0 and every row is VERIFIED or is explicitly and consistently labelled UNVERIFIED with a named kill trigger; otherwise the memo circulates as draft only."
      ],
      "outputs": [
        "signed validation record",
        "release/draft classification"
      ]
    }
  ],
  "draft_compliance_matrix": {
    "status_note": "All citations below are best-recall section-level citations written from working knowledge of 14 CFR. NONE has been confirmed against the current eCFR text; every row is UNVERIFIED (CN-20 = 0 of 28 verified) and every clause is a paraphrase to be replaced by the verbatim clause captured in Phase P1. Kill triggers make each assumption testable instead of hidden.",
    "A_eligibility_for_issuance": [
      {
        "id": "A1",
        "claim": "The applicant must be at least 18 years old (CN-01 = 18 years).",
        "citation_best_recall": "14 CFR \u00a7 65.93 (14 CFR part 65 subpart D, eligibility requirements)",
        "clause_paraphrase": "minimum age condition",
        "verify_how": "Locate the age clause in the retrieved subpart D eligibility section; capture verbatim; record the paragraph letter.",
        "status": "UNVERIFIED",
        "kill_trigger": "KT-A1: if no age condition exists in the eligibility section, delete this row and re-derive the eligibility list from the retrieved text."
      },
      {
        "id": "A2",
        "claim": "The applicant must be able to read, write, speak, and understand English.",
        "citation_best_recall": "14 CFR \u00a7 65.93",
        "clause_paraphrase": "English language proficiency condition",
        "verify_how": "Capture the verbatim language condition and note whether the four verbs are all enumerated.",
        "status": "UNVERIFIED",
        "kill_trigger": "KT-A2: if the condition is worded differently (e.g. only 'understand English'), rewrite the row to the published wording."
      },
      {
        "id": "A3",
        "claim": "The applicant must hold a mechanic certificate with both the airframe and the powerplant rating (CN-02 = 2 ratings) issued under 14 CFR part 65; one rating alone is not sufficient.",
        "citation_best_recall": "14 CFR \u00a7 65.93, with the ratings themselves in 14 CFR \u00a7\u00a7 65.75, 65.81, 65.83, 65.85",
        "clause_paraphrase": "certificate and rating prerequisite",
        "verify_how": "Confirm the rating wording and cross-check \u00a7 65.75 for the rating names; confirm whether any alternate path (e.g. repairman certificate) exists.",
        "status": "UNVERIFIED",
        "kill_trigger": "KT-A3: if subpart D accepts a single rating or a different certificate, rewrite this row and re-derive B6 (scope of authority)."
      },
      {
        "id": "A4",
        "claim": "The applicant must have been actively engaged in maintaining aircraft for at least the 24-month period preceding the date of application (CN-03 = 24 months).",
        "citation_best_recall": "14 CFR \u00a7 65.93",
        "clause_paraphrase": "recent-experience condition measured backwards from the application date",
        "verify_how": "Capture the verbatim window phrase and confirm the measurement anchor is the application date; confirm what counts as 'maintaining aircraft' if the text or associated guidance defines it.",
        "status": "UNVERIFIED",
        "kill_trigger": "KT-B: if the window is not 24 months, or the clause is absent, stop; this row is load-bearing for issuance advice and must be re-derived before use."
